name: return_constant_zero
description: Library entry that does nothing except return the constant zero. It makes no calls and touches no memory or hardware registers, so it is a stub in the info.library shared library on the disk.

name: invoke_nonzero_globals_recursively
description: Calls itself with the third argument when that is non-zero, and with the second argument plus a flag when that is non-zero. It then invokes the same routine on each of five non-zero global pointers, which is a generic dispatch over a set of library-owned objects.

name: allocate_and_link_info_structure
description: Requests a block of 812 bytes through a library call and returns zero if that fails. On success it sets about twenty internal pointers at fixed offsets inside the block, copies ten-word templates from a global into several of those areas, and returns one.

name: initialize_info_library_structures
description: Stores a set of internal pointers at fixed offsets inside a structure reached through a register, copies word templates from a global into several of those areas, and calls a helper twice with a global and two of the pointers. It returns one.

name: open_libraries_report_failure
description: Opens four library handles in sequence through a common call, storing each in a global. If one fails it passes a code of 3, 4 or 5 to a failure routine and returns zero; otherwise it returns one. The referenced text names the DOS library.

name: open_three_libraries_via_callback
description: Calls an opener held in a register three times, storing each returned handle in a global, and reports failure through a second register routine with a code of 3, 4 or 5. It returns one on success and zero on failure. The referenced text names the icon library.

name: open_two_libraries_via_callback
description: Opens two library handles through a register-held opener, storing each in a global, and reports failure through a second register routine with a code of 4 or 5. It returns one on success and zero on failure. The referenced text names the intuition library.

name: open_library_or_fail
description: Opens one library handle through a register-held opener and stores it in a global. On failure it calls the failure routine with a code of 5 and returns zero; otherwise it returns one. The referenced text names the graphics library.

name: return_constant_one
description: Library entry that does nothing except return the constant one. It makes no calls and touches no memory, so it is a stub in the info.library shared library on the disk.

name: read_cached_or_nested_value
description: Reads a structure held in a global variable and returns zero if it is missing or flagged as an error state. If a cached field in that structure is set it returns that field; otherwise it returns a longword at a fixed offset of a nested structure, chosen by a mode byte in the structure.

name: read_cached_or_nested_ptr
description: Reads a structure through a register-held pointer and returns its cached field when that field is set. Otherwise it returns a longword at a fixed offset of a nested structure chosen by a mode byte, or zero when the structure is in an error state.

name: read_value_from_nested_struct
description: Returns the cached field of a structure when it is set. Otherwise it returns a longword at a fixed offset of the structure selected by a mode byte, returning zero when that nested structure is absent.

name: read_value_from_selected_base
description: Chooses a base structure either from the structure behind one register pointer or from a second register pointer, depending on a mode byte. It returns a longword at a fixed offset of a sub-structure of that base, or zero when the second pointer is null.

name: read_value_from_base_pointer
description: Returns zero when the register-held pointer is null. Otherwise it returns a longword at a fixed offset of a sub-structure reached through that pointer.

name: lookup_disk_info_fallback
description: Stores a value in a field of a structure returned by a helper, copies a name into a 116-byte stack buffer from either a global or a field of another structure, and runs a lookup on that buffer. When the lookup fails and a mode byte is one, it returns a longword from the base structure and sets a global flag. The referenced text names disk.info.

name: check_and_set_flag
description: Passes a stack buffer and a field of a structure to a helper, then calls the helper again with a status argument of minus two and clears a global flag. If that result is zero and a mode byte is one, it returns a longword from a fixed offset of a sub-structure and sets the flag to one; otherwise it returns the first result.

name: allocate_and_link_entry_buffers
description: Allocates a 36-byte block and a 260-byte block through a memory call, and when a mode byte and a helper call succeed it links them into a structure. It sizes a further buffer from a global field with a minimum of 256, allocates it, and records related fields before returning one. It returns zero if any allocation fails.

name: allocate_entry_buffer_from_registers
description: Stores a value returned by a helper into a register-held pointer and returns zero when that value is zero. Otherwise, when a mode byte and two helper calls succeed, it initializes a sub-structure, sizes a buffer from a global field with a minimum of 256, allocates it and records related fields. It returns one on success and zero otherwise.

name: allocate_sized_entry_buffer
description: Initializes a sub-structure through a helper, then sizes a buffer from a global field with a minimum of 256 and allocates it. It records the new block and related fields in the structure, and returns one on success or zero if a step fails.

name: allocate_entry_buffer_if_ready
description: Returns zero unless a first helper call succeeds. On success it initializes a sub-structure, sizes a buffer from a global field with a minimum of 256, allocates it and records related fields, returning one only when the allocation succeeds.

name: finish_entry_buffer_setup
description: Initializes a sub-structure through a helper, sizes a buffer from a global field with a minimum of 256, allocates it and records related fields. It returns true only when the allocation succeeded.

name: copy_struct_fields_from_source
description: Copies two fields from a source structure into a destination structure, calls a helper with two values read from the source structures, and returns one.

name: setup_entry_from_context
description: Clears a set of global handles and stores the context pointer, then runs an initialization helper. It allocates a 246-byte block, fetches a handle from a global variable, and performs a series of helper calls on the resulting structures. On any failure it passes a code of 1, 5, 6 or 7 to an error routine.

name: setup_entry_with_stack_buffer
description: Uses a stack slot and register-held pointers to run a sequence of helper calls that set up an entry. It stores a fetched handle through a pointer and returns after the final call. On failure it passes a code of 1, 5 or 7 to an error routine through a register.

name: setup_entry_with_callbacks
description: Obtains a handle, and if that fails reports a code of 5 through a register callback. Otherwise it fetches a second handle from a global variable into a register slot and runs a sequence of helper calls on the entry and a stack buffer. It reports zero on success, and codes 7 or 1 on the other failure paths through the same callback.

name: setup_entry_from_global_handle
description: Stores a handle fetched from a global variable into a register slot and reports code 7 through a register callback when it is zero. Otherwise it runs a helper sequence on the stack buffer and the entry, calls a few more helpers when a global flag is clear, and reports zero on success or one if the second helper fails.

name: complete_entry_setup_checked
description: Runs two helper calls on an entry and a register-held value, then checks a global pointer and two more helper results. If any check fails it reports one through a register callback; otherwise it calls a helper when a global flag is clear, runs four more helpers and reports zero.

name: complete_entry_setup_steps
description: Calls a helper to obtain a value and then a second helper with the stack buffer. If either fails it reports one through a register callback; otherwise it calls a helper when a global flag is clear, runs four more helpers and reports zero through the same callback.

name: run_entry_finish_steps
description: Calls a helper on the stack buffer and, if that returns zero, reports one through a register callback. Otherwise it calls a helper when a global flag is clear, runs four further helpers, and reports zero through the callback.

name: call_subroutines_and_indirect_call
description: Calls a helper only when a global flag is clear, then calls four further helpers and makes an indirect call through a register pointer with zero and a stack buffer address. It returns nothing.

name: call_library_vector_132
description: Library stub that loads a library base from a global variable and calls the library function at a fixed offset of minus 132 from it. It returns nothing.

name: call_library_vector_138
description: Library stub that loads a library base from a global variable and calls the library function at a fixed offset of minus 138 from it. It returns nothing.

name: call_library_vector_198
description: Library stub that loads a library base from a global variable and calls the library function at a fixed offset of minus 198 from it. It returns nothing.

name: call_library_vector_210
description: Library stub that loads a library base from a global variable and calls the library function at a fixed offset of minus 210 from it. It returns nothing.

name: call_library_vector_246
description: Library stub that loads a library base from a global variable and calls the library function at a fixed offset of minus 246 from it. It returns nothing.

name: call_library_vector_294
description: Library stub that loads a library base from a global variable and calls the library function at a fixed offset of minus 294 from it. It returns nothing.

name: call_library_vector_372
description: Library stub that loads a library base from a global variable and calls the library function at a fixed offset of minus 372 from it. It returns nothing.

name: call_library_vector_414
description: Library stub that loads a library base from a global variable and calls the library function at a fixed offset of minus 414 from it. It returns nothing.

name: call_library_vector_552
description: Library stub that loads a library base from a global variable and calls the library function at a fixed offset of minus 552 from it. It returns nothing.

name: call_library_vector_42
description: Library stub that loads a library base from a different global variable and calls the library function at a fixed offset of minus 42 from it. It returns nothing.

name: call_library_vector_96
description: Library stub that loads a library base from a global variable and calls the library function at a fixed offset of minus 96 from it. It returns nothing.

name: call_library_vector_228
description: Library stub that loads a library base from a global variable and calls the library function at a fixed offset of minus 228 from it. It returns nothing.

name: call_library_vector_366
description: Library stub that loads a library base from a global variable and calls the library function at a fixed offset of minus 366 from it. It returns nothing.

name: call_library_vector_72
description: Library stub that loads a library base from a global variable and calls the library function at a fixed offset of minus 72 from it. It returns nothing.

name: call_library_vector_234
description: Library stub that loads a library base from a global variable and calls the library function at a fixed offset of minus 234 from it. It returns nothing.

name: call_library_vector_270
description: Library stub that loads a library base from a global variable and calls the library function at a fixed offset of minus 270 from it. It returns nothing.

name: call_library_vector_354
description: Library stub that loads a library base from a global variable and calls the library function at a fixed offset of minus 354 from it. It returns nothing.

name: build_parameter_block_and_call
description: Fills a stack parameter block with fixed constants, a value from a global pointer and the address of a global, then calls a helper with that block. If the helper returns non-zero it calls a second helper with the result, a minus-one mask and the global, and returns the result. The referenced text is a version string.

name: dispatch_state_code_action
description: Switches on a 16-bit state code read from a structure. Depending on the code it calls helpers with fields of a global structure or with the arguments, records an error flag in the global structure, or returns a fixed zero or one. Unlisted codes return one.

name: return_constant_one
description: Library entry that does nothing except return the constant one. It makes no calls and touches no memory, so it is a stub in the info.library shared library on the disk.

name: toggle_bit_for_state_code
description: Maps state codes six to nine to the single-bit masks eight, four, two and one, XORs the mask into a flag word in a global structure, and then calls a helper with a field of the second argument. Other codes store the flag word unchanged before the same helper call.

name: store_register_to_global
description: Stores the value passed in a data register into a field of a global structure, then calls a helper with a field of the structure passed in an address register. It returns nothing.

name: install_entry_and_verify_result
description: Clears or copies a 96-byte block of the global structure and calls a helper with several numeric parameters. For two mode values it stores a status word in a sub-structure, then runs a helper sequence that may create a handle and records it. It builds a name in a 40-byte stack buffer and returns one when the final checks pass, otherwise zero.

name: format_info_name_and_check
description: Formats a name with a format string ending in the info extension, using a 40-byte stack buffer and a global string. It looks the name up, creates a new handle and stores it in a structure field when the lookup fails, then runs two more helper checks and returns one if they pass. The referenced text is the format string.

name: check_disk_entry_name
description: Builds a name in a stack buffer from either a global string or a field of a structure, then looks it up with a helper. When the lookup succeeds and the structure is not in a special mode, it checks a second field with two helpers and returns one when they succeed. The referenced text is the word Disk.

name: lookup_entry_name_check
description: Formats a name into a stack buffer from a field of a structure and looks it up with a helper. It returns one immediately for a special mode value, and otherwise returns one only when a second check passes.

name: verify_entry_name_or_skip
description: Returns one straight away when a mode byte is one. Otherwise it runs a helper on a structure field and a second helper on another field; if both pass it builds a name in a 40-byte stack buffer and runs a final check, returning one on success and zero otherwise.

name: check_entry_name_pair
description: Runs a helper on two structure fields and, if it succeeds, builds a name in a 40-byte stack buffer and checks it with a second helper. It returns one when both checks pass and zero otherwise.

name: format_and_check_info_name
description: Builds a name from a global string and a structure field in a 40-byte stack buffer, using a format string ending in the info extension. It then checks the name with a helper and returns true when that check succeeds.

name: return_constant_one
description: Library entry that does nothing except return the constant one. It makes no calls and touches no memory, so it is a stub in the info.library shared library on the disk.

name: check_not_minus_one_result
description: Calls a helper with the argument, a structure field and a minus-one limit. If the result is not minus one it calls a second helper with the argument, and it returns whether the first result was not minus one.

name: call_other_and_return_one
description: Calls another routine with no arguments and then returns the constant one. It performs no other operations.

name: initialize_info_library_tables
description: Calls a helper many times with pairs of numeric values, index ranges and label pointers, passing a global variable in some calls and a structure field in a final call. The referenced text is three labels: NAME, STATUS and TYPE. It returns nothing.

name: apply_four_fixed_settings
description: Calls a helper four times with the same first parameters and fixed index values, varying only the last two numbers each time. It applies four fixed settings to a structure and returns nothing.

name: apply_seven_fixed_entries
description: Calls a helper seven times with the same first parameter and fixed index and range values, varying only the last two numbers each time. It returns nothing.

name: register_info_table_entries
description: Calls a helper nine times with the same first parameter and fixed index and range values, varying only the trailing numbers. It returns nothing.

name: set_info_table_entries
description: Calls a helper nine times with the same first parameter and fixed index and range values, varying only the trailing numbers. It returns nothing.

name: build_entry_layout_by_mode
description: Chooses one of two base values from a mode byte, then calls a helper with fixed sizes and offsets. The call uses a different set of arguments when a list in the structure is empty, and it finishes by calling a helper with a field of the parameter. It returns nothing.

name: emit_layout_for_list_state
description: Calls one of two helpers depending on whether a list in a register-held structure is empty, then calls a helper with a field of the structure at a fixed offset. It returns nothing.

name: invoke_with_offset_parameter
description: Calls a routine with no arguments, then calls a second routine with the value stored at a fixed offset of a register-held structure. It returns nothing.

name: allocate_linked_entry_list
description: Allocates a 14-byte header with memory clearing and links it into a list, clearing a flag field. For each element of a null-terminated pointer array in the structure it allocates a 14-byte entry and a 128-byte buffer, fills the buffer through a helper, and appends the entry. Returns zero if an allocation fails.

name: append_entries_to_list
description: Links the header node into the list and clears a flag field. For each element of a null-terminated pointer array in the structure it allocates a buffer, fills it through a helper, and appends a new entry. It returns early if an allocation fails, and otherwise sets a final link field.

name: populate_list_from_pointer_array
description: Walks a null-terminated pointer array, allocating a node for each element through a helper, storing a buffer address in the node and appending it to a list. It returns zero if a node allocation fails; otherwise it sets a final link field and returns the last helper result.

name: fill_list_nodes_from_array
description: Walks a null-terminated pointer array from a register-held node, filling each node's buffer through helpers and appending it to the list. It sets a final link field when the array ends and returns the last helper result, or zero if a node cannot be fetched.

name: advance_list_cursor_or_finish
description: When the list cursor sits at an end of the list, calls one helper and two helpers on the parameter structure. Otherwise it fills the current node's buffer, calls two helpers, advances the cursor and calls a helper on the parameter. It returns nothing.

name: update_library_pointer
description: Calls a helper with the buffer of the current list node and a global value, then calls a helper with no arguments. It advances the cursor to the field at offset four of the current node, then calls another helper with no arguments. It returns nothing.

name: step_list_cursor_forward
description: When the list cursor sits at an end of the list, calls three helpers on the parameter structure. Otherwise it fills the current buffer, calls two helpers, moves the cursor forward one step and calls a helper on the parameter. It returns nothing.

name: update_global_pointer_from_list
description: Calls a helper with the buffer of the current list node and a global value, then calls a helper with no arguments. It advances the cursor by dereferencing the current node, then calls another helper. It returns nothing.

name: allocate_and_insert_list_node
description: Sets a state flag. When the list is not empty it calls two helpers with the current node buffer and a global value. It then allocates a node and a 128-byte buffer, stores the buffer in the node, inserts the node into the list, updates the cursor and calls a helper with the parameter.

name: advance_list_cursor_by_direction
description: Sets a state flag. If the list is empty it calls three helpers on the parameter structure. Otherwise it fills the current buffer, calls two helpers, chooses the next or previous node as the new cursor depending on the list links, stores it, and calls a helper with the parameter. It returns nothing.

name: release_node_and_advance_cursor
description: Reads the next node from the list cursor, calls a helper on the current node to release it, and resets the cursor to the list head when the old cursor was the last node. It then calls a helper and returns nothing.

name: run_callbacks_from_structure
description: Calls a helper with no arguments, then calls it with the value at a fixed offset of a register-held structure and again with the value at another fixed offset. It returns nothing.

name: build_pointer_array_from_list
description: When a state flag is set, clears the pointer-array field of a structure if the list is empty. Otherwise it calls a helper with the cursor's buffer, counts the list nodes, allocates an array of four bytes per node, stores it in the structure and fills each slot with a buffer through helpers. Returns zero if an allocation fails, otherwise one.

name: build_pointer_array_direct
description: Clears the pointer-array field of the structure when the list is empty. Otherwise it calls a helper with the cursor's buffer, counts the list nodes, allocates an array of four bytes per node, stores it, and fills each slot with a buffer through helpers. Returns zero if an allocation fails, otherwise one.

name: clear_pointer_array_field
description: Clears the pointer-array field of a register-held structure and returns one. It has no other effect.

name: allocate_and_fill_pointer_array
description: Counts the nodes of a list, allocates an array of four bytes per node, stores it in the structure and fills each slot with a buffer through helpers. Returns zero if the array allocation or a slot allocation fails, otherwise one.

name: allocate_and_fill_counted_array
description: Counts the entries of a null-terminated pointer array, allocates a slot array of four bytes per entry, stores it in the structure, and fills each slot from the list through helpers. Returns zero when an allocation fails, otherwise one.

name: fill_pointer_array_slots
description: Calls a helper on the structure's slot-array field, then fills each slot from the list through helpers, one allocation per node, until the list ends. Returns zero if an allocation fails, otherwise one.

name: fill_pointer_array_from_cursor
description: Walks list nodes from a register-held node, allocating a buffer for each slot through a helper, storing it in a pointer array and filling it from the node's element through helpers. It returns one when the list ends and zero when an allocation fails.

name: refill_pointer_array_slots
description: Fills the current slot of a pointer array with a buffer and the element from each list node, allocating the next slot before moving on. It returns one when the list ends and zero when an allocation fails.

name: emit_layout_by_mode_switch
description: Switches on a mode byte and makes a fixed sequence of helper calls for each of six modes, with fixed numeric arguments, global values and values computed from fields of two structures. Mode values outside one to six do nothing. It returns nothing.

name: return_without_action
description: Empty routine that returns at once. It makes no calls and touches no memory, so it is a stub in the info.library shared library.

name: allocate_and_setup_mode_buffers
description: Allocates four cleared buffers of 44 bytes, 36 bytes and a size read from a structure field. If they all succeed it allocates four more buffers of 44, 36 and 116 bytes, then runs a helper sequence chosen by a mode byte and returns the last helper result. It returns zero when any allocation fails, and the mode byte itself for modes outside the handled set.

name: run_mode_sequence_result
description: Allocates four values through helpers and returns zero if any is null. Otherwise it runs one to four helper calls chosen by a mode byte, then returns the result of a final helper. Modes outside the handled set return the mode byte itself.

name: run_mode_helper_calls
description: Runs a number of helper calls chosen by a mode byte: two for mode one, three for modes two and five, four for mode three and five for mode four. It returns nothing.

name: return_without_effect
description: Empty routine that returns at once. It makes no calls and touches no memory, so it is a stub in the info.library shared library.

name: reset_or_copy_then_query
description: Sets a field of a structure to zero when a value in a global structure is zero, or otherwise copies that value into it through a helper. It then calls a helper with a minus-one limit and returns zero when that result is minus one, otherwise the result.

name: initialize_info_library
description: Calls a helper with a pointer to a global variable and a value from a structure, then calls a second helper and returns its result, replacing minus one with zero.

name: verify_four_entries_resolve
description: When a mode byte is not four, it writes fixed 16-bit values into a fixed offset of four entries. It then calls a helper with a minus-one limit on each entry and returns one only if none of the four results is minus one, otherwise zero.

name: check_three_results_valid
description: Calls a register-held routine three times and returns one if none of the results is minus one, otherwise zero.

name: check_two_results_valid
description: Calls a register-held routine twice and returns one if neither result is minus one, otherwise zero.

name: test_result_not_minus_one
description: Calls a register-held routine and returns whether its result is not minus one.

name: return_constant_one
description: Library entry that does nothing except return the constant one. It makes no calls and touches no memory, so it is a stub in the info.library shared library on the disk.

name: wait_for_bit_signal_loop
description: Repeats indefinitely. Each pass calls a helper, and if it returns a value it passes that value with a parameter to a second helper, returning zero if that fails. Otherwise it blocks on a helper called with a single bit shifted by a byte field of the structure. The loop only exits through the failure path.

name: return_constant_zero
description: Library entry that does nothing except return the constant zero. It makes no calls and touches no memory, so it is a stub in the info.library shared library on the disk.

name: handle_request_code
description: Reads a code at a fixed offset of the structure. Code four first calls a helper on a field of the structure; code 64 returns the result of a helper given the second argument; code 512 calls a helper and returns zero. Other codes call a final helper and return one.

name: dispatch_request_code_value
description: Reads a code from a data register. Code 64 returns the result of a helper, code 512 calls one helper and returns zero, and other codes call a different helper and return one. The returned value is zero only for code 512.

name: check_code_not_512
description: Calls one of two helpers depending on whether a register code is 512, and returns whether the code is not 512.

name: run_callback_then_return
description: Calls a helper with no arguments and returns nothing.

name: call_then_return_zero
description: Calls a library stub that invokes a function at offset minus 378 of a global library base, then returns zero.

name: execute_two_calls
description: Calls a routine twice with no arguments and returns one.

name: execute_multiple_callbacks
description: Calls a helper three times with the structure pointer, and a fourth time when a global mode byte is not one. It then calls a helper with a field of the structure, zero and the structure pointer, and finally calls a helper with the structure pointer and one. It returns nothing.

name: invoke_info_handler
description: Calls a helper with the argument, a small constant, the low bit of a global table field, and the address of a global. It returns nothing. The referenced text is the word DELETEABLE.

name: build_flagged_info_text
description: Fills a 20-byte stack buffer through a formatting helper, choosing two global strings or the parameter string according to a flag. When the kind argument is three it sends two entries at fixed positions, the second one using the buffer. The referenced text is a format string ending in NOT.

name: format_string_buffer
description: Formats a string into a stack buffer through a helper, using a global string and a value from the frame. It then calls two helpers when a byte argument equals three. The referenced text is a padding and format string.

name: find_string_length
description: Counts the bytes before the terminating zero byte of a string whose address is passed as a parameter, and returns that count.

name: count_bytes_to_zero
description: Advances an offset from a register base until it reaches a zero byte, and returns the count examined. It does the same job as the parameter-based length routine but with register arguments.

name: copy_cstring_to_buffer
description: Copies a null-terminated byte string from a source pointer to a destination pointer, advancing both, and includes the terminating zero byte. It returns nothing.

name: copy_counted_bytes
description: Copies a fixed number of bytes from a source pointer to a destination pointer one byte at a time, advancing both. The count is a parameter, and the routine returns nothing.

name: copy_bytes_loop
description: Copies bytes from a source register pointer to a destination register pointer one at a time until a counter reaches a limit held in another register. It returns nothing and makes no library calls.

name: compare_two_strings
description: Walks two byte strings in step until one ends or the bytes differ, and returns whether the bytes at that point are equal.

name: compare_strings_in_registers
description: Advances two register-held string pointers in step until a zero byte or a mismatch, and returns whether the bytes at the stopping point are equal.

name: count_bytes_including_terminator
description: Walks a string from a pointer parameter until the zero byte and returns the number of bytes examined, which is the string length plus one for the terminator.

name: process_with_offset_decrement
description: Calls a helper with a parameter to obtain a value, then makes three calls through a function pointer in a structure field: one with the third argument and the fourth argument minus ten, one with the second argument, and one with the fifth argument and the obtained value. It returns nothing.

name: prepare_text_argument_buffer
description: Fills an 11-byte stack buffer through a helper using a global value and the last argument, then passes the four leading arguments and the buffer to a second helper. It returns nothing.

name: copy_length_prefixed_string
description: Copies a length-prefixed string from a table entry: the first byte gives the count, the following bytes are copied to the destination, and a zero byte ends it. The entry address is a parameter scaled by four, which is unusual, and the code comes from a gap in the listing, so it may be misdecoded data.

name: copy_bytes_with_terminator
description: Copies bytes from a source register pointer, offset by a counter, to a destination with the same offset, up to a limit held in a register, then writes a zero byte after the copied range. It uses only the registers shown and makes no library calls.

name: initialize_two_structures_and_call
description: Fills two structures passed as pointers with fixed values from its parameters, then calls a helper on each of two sources and on the second structure with a minus-one limit. When that result is not minus one it calls a helper with a field of the first argument, and it returns whether the result was not minus one.

name: call_other_routine_with_argument
description: Calls a routine with the value stored at a fixed offset of a register-held structure, then returns one.

name: clear_library_entry
description: Calls a library function through a pointer in a structure field three times: once with the second argument, once with zero, and once with the third and fourth arguments and the fifth and sixth arguments minus ten. It returns nothing.

name: call_raw_do_fmt
description: Library stub that calls the RawDoFmt function of the exec library through a global base at a fixed offset of minus 522. It returns nothing.

name: store_byte_at_pointer
description: Writes the low byte of a data register to the address held in an address register and returns nothing.

name: call_library_vector_36
description: Library stub that loads a library base from a global table and calls the library function at a fixed offset of minus 36 from it. It returns nothing.

name: call_library_vector_72
description: Library stub that loads a library base from a global table and calls the library function at a fixed offset of minus 72 from it. It returns nothing.

name: return_constant_zero
description: Entry point of the version library that does nothing except return the constant zero. It makes no calls or memory accesses.

name: store_two_fields_in_structure
description: Stores two longwords, one from an address register and one from a stack-frame value, into fixed fields of a structure whose address is in a data register. It returns nothing.

name: increment_counter_and_clear_flag
description: Increments a short counter at a fixed offset from a base pointer and clears one bit in a flag byte at another offset. It performs only these two memory updates and returns nothing.

name: decrement_counter_and_call
description: Decrements a short counter at a fixed offset from a base pointer. When the counter reaches zero and a particular bit in a flag byte is set, it calls another routine and returns its result, otherwise it returns zero.

name: signal_when_counter_expires
description: When a short counter at a fixed offset is zero, calls two library functions through a base pointer at offsets minus 252 and minus 210, and returns a longword stored at another offset. Otherwise it sets a flag bit and returns zero.

name: get_library_value
description: Reads a longword at a fixed offset of a passed pointer, calls two library functions through a base pointer at offsets minus 252 and minus 210, and returns the longword read.

name: return_constant_zero
description: Library entry that does nothing except return the constant zero. It makes no calls and touches no memory, so it is a stub in the version.library shared library on the disk.

name: store_handle_if_allocated
description: Calls a library function at offset minus 84 of a base pointer. If it returns a non-zero handle it stores an argument into the handle's field at offset 34 and calls a second library function at offset minus 396. It returns whether the handle was non-zero.

name: check_and_set_font_handle
description: Calls a library function at offset minus 84 of a base pointer. If it returns a non-zero handle it stores an argument into the handle's field at offset 34 and calls a second library function at offset minus 396. It returns whether the handle was non-zero.

name: open_libraries_and_init_list
description: Opens two libraries through the exec library's open function at offset minus 552. If both succeed it initializes a list head inside the structure passed in a data register and returns that structure. Otherwise it calls two other library functions, at offsets minus 414 and minus 210, and returns zero. The referenced text names dos.library and graphics.library.

name: close_library_and_free_memory
description: Closes a library through the exec library's close function at offset minus 414, then frees the structure passed in a register through the free function at offset minus 210. It returns zero.

name: unload_segments_and_release
description: Walks a list of entries, unlinking each entry whose counter is below one and unloading its segment through the dos library's UnLoadSeg function. When the structure's own counter is zero it closes two libraries, frees the structure and returns a stored handle. Otherwise it sets a flag bit and returns zero.

name: release_when_unused
description: When a counter and a count field in the structure are both zero, it closes two libraries, frees the structure, unlinks it from its list, and returns a stored handle. Otherwise it sets a flag bit and returns zero.

name: set_flag_and_return_zero
description: Sets the high bit of a flag byte at a fixed offset in a structure and returns zero.

name: return_without_action
description: Empty routine that returns at once. It makes no calls and touches no memory, so it is a stub in the diskfont.library shared library.

name: clear_flag_and_increment_counter
description: Clears the high bit of a flag byte at a fixed offset and increments a short counter at another fixed offset. It returns nothing.

name: decrement_counter_and_call_handler
description: Decrements a short counter at offset 38 of a structure. When it stays non-zero and the high bit of a flag byte is set, it calls a function at offset minus 18 of the structure base and returns that result. Otherwise it returns zero.

name: return_constant_zero
description: Library entry that does nothing except return the constant zero. It makes no calls and touches no memory, so it is a stub in the diskfont.library shared library.

name: collect_font_entries_into_buffer
description: Writes a count to the first word of a buffer and appends font entries after it. When one flag bit is set it appends records from an in-memory list of names; when the other flag bit is set it also scans the font directory for matching font files and appends their records. Each record copies a name and a fixed header. It returns the number of bytes the buffer is short, or zero when everything fits.

name: append_font_list_records
description: Appends one record per entry of an in-memory list to a buffer, each with a copied name and a fixed header. When the second flag bit is set it also scans the font directory and appends records for matching font files. It returns the number of bytes the buffer is short, or zero when everything fits.

name: append_name_and_font_records
description: Copies name characters into a buffer and appends a record for each name entry. When the second flag bit is set it also scans the font directory and appends records for matching font files. It returns the number of bytes the buffer is short, or zero.

name: scan_font_directory_records
description: When the second flag bit is set, opens a lock on the FONTS directory, examines its entries, and for each matching font file reads its header and fixed-size records into the buffer. It releases the lock when done and returns the number of bytes the buffer is short, or zero when all records fit. The referenced text names the FONTS directory and the font extension.

name: append_list_entry_records
description: Copies the name of each in-memory font list entry into a buffer and appends a record with a fixed header per entry. It then closes the list and returns the number of bytes the buffer is short, or zero when all records fit.

name: read_font_names_from_file
description: Reads a file byte by byte to build font name strings in a buffer. For each name it reads a four-byte header and, when the header matches a fixed value, reads and appends records. It returns the number of bytes the buffer is short, or zero when all records fit.

name: read_font_records_from_file
description: Reads fixed-size records of 260 bytes from an open file and appends each full record that fits into the buffer with a header. It then closes the file and returns the number of bytes the buffer is short, or zero when all records fit.

name: finish_font_directory_scan
description: Releases a saved directory lock through the dos unlock call, then calls a second library function at offset minus 420 of a base, and returns the number of bytes the buffer is short, or zero when all records fit.

name: return_constant_zero
description: Library entry that does nothing except return the constant zero. It makes no calls and touches no memory, so it is a stub in the diskfont.library shared library.

name: score_entry_bit_differences
description: Returns minus 32767 when the entry's 16-bit value is zero. Otherwise it starts from 32767 adjusted by the scaled difference of two 16-bit values, then subtracts a weight from a table for each differing bit in two flag bytes across seven bit positions, and returns that score.

name: score_flag_bit_differences
description: Starts from a register value adjusted by a scaled 16-bit difference, then subtracts a table weight for each differing bit in two flag bytes across seven bit positions. It returns the resulting score.

name: subtract_weights_for_bits
description: Walks seven bit positions and subtracts a table weight from the score for each position whose bits in two flag bytes of an entry match a mask. It returns the reduced score.

name: subtract_weights_for_masked_bits
description: Walks seven bit positions and subtracts a table weight for each position selected by a mask in one of two flag bytes of an entry. It returns the reduced score.

name: return_negative_sentinel
description: Returns a fixed sentinel score of minus 32767, with no calls or memory access.

name: select_best_matching_font_entry
description: Copies an 8-byte font name key from a parameter and looks it up in the in-memory font list and in the FONTS: directory. It scores candidate entries with the score routines, keeps the best scoring one, and adds matching entries to the list. It returns the chosen entry or zero. The referenced text is FONTS:.

name: select_best_font_from_file
description: Reads font records from a file in blocks of 260 bytes, after a four-byte header that must match a fixed value. It scores each record against a key with the score routines, keeps the best scoring entry, and returns it or zero. It also closes the file and unlocks the directory before returning.

name: add_best_scoring_font_entries
description: Repeatedly picks the highest-scoring entry from an in-memory list, marks it, and links it into the font list, until no entry scores above the threshold. It then closes the scan and returns the last chosen entry.

name: load_and_register_best_fonts
description: Scores list entries against a key and keeps the best one. For each chosen entry with the expected type code it loads the font segment, adds it to the font tail list and registers it with the graphics font list, then continues until nothing is left. It returns the last chosen entry.

name: register_fonts_from_previous_entry
description: Scores list entries against a key and picks the best one, starting from a previous entry. Chosen entries with the expected type code are linked into the font list and registered; others are marked unused. It returns the last chosen entry when no candidates remain.

name: register_scored_fonts_and_close
description: Scores entries against a key, registers each chosen entry with the expected type code in the font list and graphics font list, and marks non-matching entries as unused. When no entries remain it closes the font and directory handles it holds and returns the last chosen entry.

name: call_exec_forbid
description: Library stub that calls the exec library's Forbid function through a global base at offset minus 132. It returns nothing.

name: call_exec_permit

name: call_exec_allocmem
description: Library stub that calls the exec library's AllocMem function through a global base at offset minus 198. It returns nothing.

name: call_exec_freemem
description: Library stub that calls the exec library's FreeMem function through a global base at offset minus 210. It returns nothing.

name: copy_null_terminated_string
description: Copies bytes from a source pointer to a destination pointer until and including a null terminator. It returns nothing.

name: seek_string_end_and_call
description: Advances a pointer to the terminating zero byte of a string, then calls a helper with that pointer and a second argument. It returns nothing.

name: call_helper_and_return
description: Calls one routine with no arguments and returns nothing. It is a wrapper with no other work.

name: count_string_length
description: Walks a zero-terminated string from a pointer parameter and returns the number of bytes before the terminator.

name: return_without_action
description: Empty routine that returns at once. It makes no calls and touches no memory, so it is a stub in the diskfont.library shared library.

name: compare_strings_ordered
description: Compares two zero-terminated strings byte by byte. At the first differing byte it returns minus one when the first string's byte is smaller, otherwise one. If the strings are equal it returns zero.

name: compare_preceding_byte
description: Compares the byte just before one register pointer with the byte at another register pointer. It returns minus one when the earlier byte is smaller, otherwise one.

name: find_char_in_string
description: Walks a zero-terminated string looking for a given byte value. It returns a pointer to the first matching byte, or null if the string ends first.

name: find_char_after_pointer
description: Advances a pointer past its current position and searches forward for a given byte value. It returns a pointer to the first match, or null when the string's zero byte comes first.

name: return_constant_zero
description: Library entry that does nothing except return the constant zero. It makes no calls and touches no memory, so it is a stub in the diskfont.library shared library.

name: find_last_char_in_string
description: Finds the last occurrence of a byte value in a zero-terminated string by walking backwards from the end. It returns a pointer to that byte, or null when the value is not present.

name: scan_backwards_for_char
description: Scans backward from a register pointer toward a lower bound held in another register, looking for a given byte. It returns a pointer to the match, or null when the bound is reached first.

name: return_constant_zero
description: Library entry that does nothing except return the constant zero. It makes no calls and touches no memory, so it is a stub in the diskfont.library shared library.

name: find_path_separator
description: Searches a zero-terminated string for a slash character, and if none is found for a colon character. It returns the pointer to the match, or the original string pointer when neither character is present.
